evidenceLevels.definition: Implementation values and their known provenance are recorded. Predictive accuracy has not been checked against a suitable external dataset.
One or more parameters were fitted to the reported observations. No physically separate holdout observations establish predictive error.
Output is compared with a manufacturer or publication table under the documented assumptions. This does not establish independent empirical accuracy.
Output is compared with a separately implemented solver or reference model under stated assumptions and tolerances.
Predictions are compared with measured observations that were excluded from parameter fitting.

reportArtifacts.title: Independent G7 RK4 comparison
reportArtifacts.claimBoundary: Checks production G7 trajectories against a fixed-step implementation across supersonic, transonic, and subsonic cases. It does not test projectile-specific BC accuracy.

reportArtifacts.title: Independent trajectory matrix
reportArtifacts.claimBoundary: Checks the declared trajectory equations and event calculations across the registered matrix. Shared physical model assumptions are outside this comparison.

reportArtifacts.title: Manufacturer and publication velocity tables
reportArtifacts.claimBoundary: Checks reproduced table values under an assumed atmosphere. Loads fitted to the same table remain calibration evidence.

reportArtifacts.title: Atmosphere property references
reportArtifacts.claimBoundary: Checks density, sound speed, and viscosity only inside each report section's declared domain.

reportArtifacts.title: Adaptive solver convergence
reportArtifacts.claimBoundary: Checks numerical convergence and an analytical constant-Cd case. It does not validate the physical drag models.

reportArtifacts.title: Built-in effective-BC fits
reportArtifacts.claimBoundary: Reproduces implemented fitted coefficients from their calibration inputs. No fit has an empirical holdout.

reportArtifacts.title: Native calculation benchmarks
reportArtifacts.claimBoundary: Records timings on the named platform and compiler. Timings are report-only and do not define a cross-machine pass threshold.

reportArtifacts.title: Full interaction performance budget
reportArtifacts.claimBoundary: Checks the declared warm and cold p95 budgets on the current host. Results do not predict every supported machine.

models.description: Morrison Reynolds-dependent smooth-sphere drag with the Collins compressibility correction

declaredValidity.behaviorOutsideDomain: calculation continues with a structured extrapolation warning

models.description: User-supplied projectile drag coefficients with linear interpolation and a physical force equation based on an explicit frontal reference diameter

declaredValidity.mach: bounded by the first and last user-supplied knots
declaredValidity.behaviorOutsideDomain: the nearest endpoint Cd is held constant and a structured extrapolation warning is returned

models.interpolation: Piecewise linear, exact at knots, with no spline overshoot
models.forceLaw: a_drag = rho * Cd * A * v_air^2 / (2 * mass), A = pi * referenceDiameter^2 / 4
sources: User-supplied numerical curve. The user is responsible for its provenance.

models.description: Deterministic weighted nonlinear least-squares estimation of constant or fixed-threshold velocity-banded G1/G7 ballistic coefficients from range/velocity observations
models.objective: sum of squared (predicted - measured) velocity divided by supplied one-sigma uncertainty, using calibration-role observations only
models.intervals: Approximate local 95% intervals from inverse weighted J^T J on the log-BC scale. Variance scale is max(1, reduced chi-square).
models.validationBoundary: holdout observations are excluded from fitting and reported separately. A fit without holdout data cannot return a validation-ready state.
testEvidence: synthetic constant-G1 coefficient recovery and confidence coverage
real CLI protocol fixture with separate calibration and holdout residuals

models.description: Deterministic local propagation of independent one-sigma scenario inputs into aligned trajectory-output standard deviations
models.method: bounded central finite-difference sensitivities with independent root-sum-square variance combination
models.confidenceDisplay: approximate two-sided 95% half-width equals 1.9599639845 times propagated standard deviation
models.zeroingSemantics: Muzzle velocity, drag, atmosphere, and wind hold nominal bore elevation fixed. Zero-range perturbations re-solve bore elevation.
limitations: model-form and spin-drift uncertainty are excluded
correlated or materially nonlinear cases should use the separate Monte Carlo method
testEvidence: muzzle-only analytic launch-point speed, energy, and momentum sensitivities
real CLI protocol fixture with aligned complete uncertainty samples

models.description: Range-domain analysis of a natively zeroed trajectory for sight-line zeros, maximum ordinate, Mach-regime crossings, supersonic range, and ground intersection
models.interpolation: Cubic Hermite interpolation in range uses integrated vertical position and vy/vx slope. Mach crossings use linear interpolation between retained dense states.
models.availability: Each event family reports complete, horizon_limited, baseline_unavailable, or not_applicable as appropriate. An endpoint is never substituted for a missing crossing.
testEvidence: configured far-zero recovery and ordered near/far crossings
maximum ordinate between the sight-line zeros
Mach-1 crossing consistency with supersonic range
ground intersection and explicit short-horizon availability

source.title: Revised formula for the density of moist air (CIPM-2007)
source.author: A. Picard, R. S. Davis, M. Glaser, and K. Fujii
source.publisher: Metrologia, copy hosted by the National Institute of Standards and Technology

datasets.normalization: Values are generated directly from the CIPM-2007 equations and constants at a carbon-dioxide mole fraction of 0.0004. Decimal output is deterministically rounded to 12 places. Cases remain inside 15 to 27 degrees Celsius and 600 to 1100 hPa.
datasets.uncertainty: The source estimates a relative standard uncertainty of 22 parts in 10^6 over the stated pressure and temperature ranges, excluding uncertainty in measured environmental inputs. This comparison evaluates formula agreement, not sensor uncertainty.

redistribution.note: Only independently generated equation outputs and source metadata are stored. The NIST-hosted paper is linked and is not redistributed.

source.title: Equations, Tables, and Charts for Compressible Flow
source.author: Ames Research Staff
source.publisher: National Advisory Committee for Aeronautics, NASA Technical Reports Server

datasets.normalization: Values are generated from equation A3 using absolute temperature in degrees Rankine, then converted from pound-force seconds per square foot to pascal seconds. The selected cases cover the application's complete -60 to 60 degree Celsius input range and remain inside the report's stated 180 to 3400 degree Rankine range for Sutherland's formula.
datasets.uncertainty: The source describes Sutherland's equation as the more accurate approximation across its stated range but does not publish a numerical uncertainty for equation A3. This is formula conformance, not an empirical viscosity uncertainty claim.

redistribution.note: Only independently generated equation outputs and source metadata are stored. NASA identifies the report as US Government work with public use permitted. The PDF is linked and is not redistributed.

source.title: Speed of sound in humid air: Accurate thermodynamic model and experimental validation
source.author: R. M. Gavioso, M. Astrua, M. Zucco, and M. Pisani
source.publisher: Journal of Physical and Chemical Reference Data

datasets.normalization: Four rows at 0, 20, 30, and 50 degrees Celsius from Table 5 are transcribed exactly. One atmosphere is converted from 1 atm to 1013.25 hPa. No sound-speed or uncertainty value is converted. The 50 degree Celsius row retains its published 10 kHz frequency so the report does not mislabel it as a zero-frequency datum. The 2 atm row is excluded because it lies outside the application pressure input domain.
datasets.uncertainty: The table's per-row standard uncertainties are preserved. The cases all use a carbon-dioxide mole fraction of 0.000368. Three cases are inside the declared Cramer sound-speed domain and the 50 degree Celsius case explicitly exercises extrapolation. They do not validate the application's complete pressure, composition, or frequency domain.

redistribution.note: Only four numerical table rows from the open-access paper are transcribed. The paper and its software are linked and are not redistributed.
